title: AI Assistant
description: A full-height assistant conversation with a scrolling message log, an answer carrying a table and a draft, a reply in progress and a composer pinned to the bottom.
summary: Chat log, pending reply and composer in one viewport-tall column.
notes: The block is one 100dvh column: the header and composer stay put and only the conversation scrolls. The log starts at its newest message without JavaScript, through a column-reverse scroller around a single chronological thread. Set a smaller block size on .ab-assistant when it sits inside a page.

Nothing is sent, streamed or stored. Sending, streaming, the Stop button, feedback state (aria-pressed), copying and attachments belong to your application. A textarea inserts a new line on Enter; send-on-Enter is application code.

The conversation container has role="log", so messages your application appends are announced politely. The pending reply announces its status through role="status" on the shimmer label; only the placeholder lines are aria-busy.
The composer grows with its text in browsers that support field-sizing: content, up to 12rem; elsewhere it keeps one size and scrolls. With reduced motion the shimmer and skeleton stay still.
